description: Source code for a class 'QtCreatorWriter' that generates Qt Creator project files based on build targets and dependencies, including functions for discovering targets, collecting dependencies, handling target files, and generating configuration files.

classes.name: QtCreatorWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Qt Creator project files based on build targets and dependencies.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method to initiate the process of creating the Qt Creator project directory, instantiate the writer, and generate project files.

methods.name: QtCreatorWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with build settings, builder, project prefix, and root target name.

methods.name: CollectDeps
methods.description: Recursively collects all dependencies of a given target.

methods.name: DiscoverTargets
methods.description: Discovers and sets the relevant build targets based on the root target name.

methods.name: AddToSources
methods.description: Adds files to the sources list from a given list of target files.

methods.name: HandleTarget
methods.description: Processes a build target to collect source files, headers, include directories, and defines.

methods.name: GenerateFile
methods.description: Generates a project configuration file with a given suffix and list of items.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main execution method to generate all project files after discovering targets.
